features.label: Merchant listing
features.description: Name, image and an offer with a price and a currency. Recommended and not there:

features.label: Review stars
features.description: An average rating and the number of reviews behind it. Every recommended value is there too.

features.label: Breadcrumb
features.description: At least two levels, each with a position, a name and an address. Every recommended value is there too.

blocks.name: Product
blocks.json:
{
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "Product",
    "name": "Leather care kit",
    "description": "A waxed canvas satchel with a leather strap.",
    "sku": "LC-CARE-01",
    "brand": {
        "@type": "Brand",
        "name": "Linden & Co."
    },
    "color": "Tan",
    "offers": {
        "@type": "Offer",
        "url": "https://shop.example/bags/field-satchel.html",
        "price": "240.00",
        "priceCurrency": "EUR",
        "availability": "https://schema.org/InStock",
        "itemCondition": "https://schema.org/NewCondition",
        "hasMerchantReturnPolicy": {
            "@type": "MerchantReturnPolicy",
            "applicableCountry": [
                "DE",
                "AT"
            ],
            "returnPolicyCategory": "https://schema.org/MerchantReturnFiniteReturnWindow",
            "merchantReturnDays": 30,
            "returnMethod": "https://schema.org/ReturnByMail",
            "returnFees": "https://schema.org/FreeReturn"
        }
    }
}
